title: Chaifetz Center for Entrepreneurship to Hold 2026 Entrepreneurship Hall of Fame December 3
summary_en: The Chaifetz Center for Entrepreneurship at Saint Louis University will hold its 2026 Entrepreneurship Hall of Fame induction ceremony at a dinner on Thursday, Dec. 3, at the Richard A. Chaifetz School of Business.
